scope: Current unified-semantic-graph Tasks. R4.3-024/025 supersedes older Protocol/dry-run/translation-proof execution requirements. Historical retained runs and evidence are not rewritten or automatically resumed.

request.candidate_ref: run-relative immutable stage3-neutral-graph/candidates/<candidate>-r<revision>.json, or null for supported fields-only changes including Class/relation_type creation
request.changes: nonempty ordered list of the closed change shape below

rules: change_id is a unique neutral operation label. item_id selects the complete current candidate item; fields is null. fields-only existing modifications use item_id=null. Do not copy a candidate into fields.

create selects a candidate item for the seven unified kinds; target_ref=null. Supported Class/relation_type/Operation/Mapping create uses item_id=null, target_ref=null and fields containing its semantic fields. update/delete/fact operations require a concrete retained target_ref. Missing candidate items never imply deletion.

target_ref and existing_resource_ref are {artifact_ref,path}; path is a JSON Pointer to one actual authorized governed response or applied receipt entry. No bare guessed resource IRI/ID, Session, lease, version, Batch identity, command_kind, payload envelope or command plan.
Ontology placement comes from the confirmed topology and trusted run scope, not from guessed table/slice counts. An unresolved placement is a fixable scope_binding_required error.

value_rules.entity: create_entity semantic fields; label required, no fabricated Class. Class references use definition_ref or authorized existing_resource_ref. properties uses [{property_ref,value}] with unique property refs. Preserve optional semantic_definition/action_definition/parameter_definition.
value_rules.property: name required; explicit predicate_kind=fact|relation. fact requires datatype. datatype and object_class_id are mutually exclusive. Only semantic_definition annotation is supported.
value_rules.relation: value={predicate: definition_ref or existing_resource_ref}; relation_endpoints={from_item_id,to_item_id}. Preserve explicit direction. No silent relation annotation loss: express additional local conditions with ordinary nodes as appropriate.
value_rules.table_mapping/join_mapping/enum_meaning/: Use existing current batch create business fields, without technical resource identity. Resolve references only in declared reference slots. Do not introduce SQL/DSN/source_id/run_id import variants.

candidate.unknowns: Preserve business_meaning and all declared unknowns in supported semantic_definition fields; conflicting same-name meanings are errors. Candidate-level explicit_unknowns remain in submission/handoff gaps; execution success alone never proves they are retrievable or the whole scenario is complete.
candidate.legacy_value: A legal old value that cannot uniquely compile requires an explicit new immutable revision; the program does not guess or rewrite the old artifact.

semantic_level: entity/create_entity creates an owl:NamedIndividual, including when no Class is supplied. An asserted relation between individuals states an instance fact. Class/relation_type definitions are available as fields-only changes for concept-level semantics; do not force concepts into individuals or invent candidate kinds. A complete immutable fields-only change request is a semantic delivery, not a command plan. definition_ref selects a candidate item in this submission, not a fields-only change_id. To connect new fields-only Classes, first create them, then use actual retained receipt entries through existing_resource_ref for the relationship definition. The program executes the selected semantics and does not choose this business distinction for Modeling.
execution: Program compiles all statically checkable input before the first write, preserves candidate item identities and JSON Pointer source maps, orders explicit dependencies, obtains real Session/lease/revision, and calls apply_atomic once per batch. Cross-batch dependencies use successful actual resource outputs. No dry-run, translation approval, or cross-batch transaction claim.

results.rule: Trust applied receipts. Index failed/unknown is separate from write state; never reapply to repair search. Reconcile uncertain original identities before dependent writes. Correct ordinary input errors within the same goal. Preserve actual resource kind, source item/change, Batch/Attempt, revisions, index state and first blocker.
results.resource_references: Each resource_bindings member with observed resource outputs and a retained receipt includes existing_resource_ref={artifact_ref,path}, computed from its actual raw receipt item matched by client_item_id. Select a member by change_id/item_id and copy its reference into target_ref or an existing_resource_ref wrapper. resource_bindings order and request order need not match the raw receipt items order; never construct receipt pointers from their array indexes. These are technical identities, not inferred business endpoints.

self_check: At valuable successful stages query_semantic_context with public questions in explicit authorized ontologies scope, then expand actual returned IRI anchors and full definitions. Current hybrid/adaptive/relevance defaults apply. Preserve revision/index/cursor/completeness and authorization limitations; lexical fallback/no match is not proof of model absence or global completeness.
handoff: Use existing maps/handoffs for submission/query references, findings/dispositions and gaps. Final full governed association check remains required once before handoff, not after every batch. Final Consumer/Judge stays independent and cannot repair the production run. Real modeling starts/repair rounds still require existing user authorization.
